introduce:
Lay prone on the ground with arms supporting your body. 

Keep your body straight while raising and lowering your body with your arms. 

This exercise works the chest, shoulders, triceps, back and legs.
name: PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Put your wrists directly under your shoulders.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, elevate your feet on a bench.
To make it more challenging, clap your hands when pushing up.
Too hard for you? You can elevate your hands on a bench.
If you feel it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
To make it easier, do it with your hands against a wall.
This exercise really works on your chest, abs and triceps.
This exercise helps build your strength and endurance.
Adjust your performance if you feel strain in your shoulders.

introduce: Start in the regular push-up position but with your hands spread wider than your shoulders. \n\nThen push your body up and down. Remember to keep your body straight.
name: WIDE ARM PUSH-UPS

tips.text: We suggest you do the exercise on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't put too much pressure on your shoulders.
Do not sink or raise your hips.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it easier, lower your knees on the mat, and cross your ankles in the air.
Your chest should be engaged.
It's not right if you feel too much pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise primarily targets your chest.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Then elevate your feet on a chair or bench, and push your body up and down mainly using your arm strength. 

Remember to keep your body straight.
name: DECLINE PUSH-UPS

tips.text: Please prepare a bench or chair.
Keep your body straight.
Keep your abs tight.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If it's too hard for you, perform a traditional push-up.
This works your chest.

introduce: Stand with one of your legs forward and your knees bent slightly. Bend your elbows and clench your fists in front of your face.\n\nExtend one arm forward with the palm facing the floor. Take the arm back and repeat with the other arm.
name: PUNCHES

tips.text: Fully extend your arm with each punch.
Tighten your core.
Do it as fast as you can.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.

introduce:
Find a doorway, take a lunge position in the doorway with your arms on the doorframe and your elbows a little lower than your shoulders, then slowly bring your chest forward. 

Hold this position for 30-40 seconds. Then slowly come out of it, bring your arms down and do a couple of shoulder rolls.

Don’t pull your head forward, and keep your neck relaxed.
name: CHEST STRETCH

tips.text: Please stand in front of a doorway.
Please keep you neck relaxed.
Please don’t pull your lower back or head forward.
You should feel stretch in your chest and shoulders.
You shouldn\'t feel any pain.
Inhale deeply and slowly, feeling your chest expand.
Exhale slowly, feeling your chest contract.
This exercise stretches your chest and shoulders.

introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. 

Hold a dumbbell in each hand, and raise your arms towards the ceiling with your palms facing each other and your elbows slightly bent. 

Lower the dumbbells out to the sides until your upper arms touch the floor. Return and repeat the exercise.
name: DUMBBELL CHEST FLY

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells.
Please do this on a mat.
Please always keep your back flat on the floor.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
You should feel your chest engaged.
This exercise works your chest muscles.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your hands gripping the back of the chair.\n\nInhale deeply and open up your chest and shoulders. Hold for a few seconds.
name: SHOULDER STRETCH WITH CHAIR

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Don't shrug your shoulders.
Breathe deeply and steadily.

introduce:
Lie on a bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand. 

Extend your arms with your hands toward the ceiling and palms facing forward. 

Bend and lower your elbows to your sides, then push the dumbbells straight up. Repeat the exercise.
name: DUMBBELL BENCH PRESS

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells that you feel comfortable with.
Please prepare a bench.
Please make sure your wrists are straight.
Please bring your elbows slightly close to your body when lowering them.
You shouldn’t feel too much stress in your shoulders.
You should feel your chest working.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise works your chest.
